name: agent-dispatch
description: Advance the frontier of a map issue: self-grill every startable needs-triage sub-issue with subagents, decide what the evidence settles, ask the human the rest, rewrite each issue as an agent contract, mark it ready-for-agent, dispatch implement or diagnosing-bugs subagents that run their own adversarial reviewer before handing over, final-review every PR, and keep going as PRs merge until the map is done.
